method: Set card search in Esper colors for discard, graveyard and copy effects, cross-checked with Hashaton's EDHREC page
summary: Hashaton copies every creature card you discard as a 4/4 Zombie for {2}{U}, and the copy keeps the card's abilities. So the best new cards are cheap ways to discard (looting, connive, landcycling creatures) and big creatures whose abilities are great on a 4/4 body. First pass: Secrets of Strixhaven, Marvel Super Heroes, The Hobbit and Reality Fracture still have card search pages I couldn't read yet, so more ideas may come.

picks.name: Avacyn, Angel of Horror
picks.why: Eight mana to cast, but you'll mostly discard it. For {2}{U} Hashaton gives you a 4/4 flying, deathtouch Avacyn that returns each of your nontoken creatures to the battlefield when it dies. Already one of the most-played new cards in Hashaton decks on EDHREC.

picks.name: Liliana the Faultless
picks.why: A one-mana repeatable discard outlet: {1}, tap, discard a card to give Hashaton or another creature hexproof. Protects your commander and feeds its trigger at the same time. Also gains life as creatures enter.
picks.cutWhy: Liliana does more work every turn

picks.name: Arni, Humble Scribe
picks.why: Three-mana looter with no activation cost: tap to draw then discard. It untaps whenever another nontoken creature enters, so a reanimation turn can loot several times.

picks.name: Divining Duelist
picks.why: Flash 3/2 that can loot when it enters. Instant-speed discard lets you hold up Hashaton mana on opponents' turns.

skipped.name: Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun
skipped.reason: Gives your spells split second; doesn't help a creature-discard plan.

picks.name: Bard, King of Dale
picks.why: Doubles your tokens and your extra card draw. Every Hashaton trigger makes two Zombie copies, and your loot effects draw double. Works as a 4/4 token copy too, so you can discard it and still get the effect.

picks.name: Captain of Umbar
picks.why: Three-mana creature with {1}, tap: draw then discard. A steady discard outlet every turn.

picks.name: Confusticate and Bebother
picks.why: Flexible instant: soft counter, or draw two and discard one. Covers interaction and a discard in one card.
picks.cutWhy: more flexible at the same job

picks.name: Along the Crooked Way
picks.why: Enchantment that returns a creature card from your graveyard to hand when it enters, so you can discard it again for another Hashaton copy.

sets.name: Marvel Super Heroes

picks.name: A.I.M. Scientists
picks.why: Connives when it enters, and has basic landcycling {2}. Landcycling counts as discarding a creature card, so early it fetches a land and still triggers Hashaton.

picks.name: Daily Bugle Newspaper
picks.why: Two-mana artifact: {2}, tap to loot and make a Treasure. A discard outlet that also ramps, so it pays for Hashaton's {2}{U}.

picks.name: Doctor Jane Foster
picks.why: Returns a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard, to the battlefield if you gained life this turn (Liliana the Faultless and Gray Merchant help).

sets.note: Only the first of four search result pages could be read.

sets.name: Secrets of Strixhaven

picks.name: Fix What's Broken
picks.why: Mass reanimation: pay X life to return every artifact and creature card with mana value exactly X. Good when you've discarded several big creatures of the same cost.

skipped.name: Forum Necroscribe
skipped.reason: Its reanimation needs spells that target creatures, which this deck has few of.

sets.note: Only the first of four search result pages could be read.

picks.name: The Cloning of Shredder
picks.why: Saga that exiles a creature card from your graveyard and makes a token copy of it, then makes more copies on chapters II and III. Three copies of your best discarded creature for six mana.

picks.name: Stockman, Mad Fly-entist
picks.why: Islandcycling {2} on a creature: early game it finds a land and triggers Hashaton. Later it's a flyer that loots when it enters.
picks.cutWhy: Stockman fixes mana and feeds the commander

picks.name: Bebop, Warthog Warrior
picks.why: Swampcycling {2} creature with menace. Same idea as Stockman: a land early, a Hashaton trigger either way.

picks.name: Jennika, Bad Apple Big Sister
picks.why: Plainscycling {2} creature that makes a 2/2 when it enters. Another landcycler for the white side.

picks.name: Karai, Future of the Foot
picks.why: Orzhov 3-drop: combat damage returns a creature card from your graveyard to hand, or to the battlefield if it was sneaked in.

picks.name: Thirst for Identity
picks.why: Instant: draw three, then discard two unless you discard a creature card. In this deck you'll almost always discard one creature, which triggers Hashaton. Already showing up in Hashaton lists on EDHREC.

picks.name: Grave Venerations
picks.why: Makes you the monarch, returns a creature card from your graveyard to hand each end step while you stay monarch (so you can discard it again), and drains when your creatures die. Your 4/4 Zombies help keep the crown.

picks.name: Iron-Shield Elf
picks.why: Two-mana creature with a free outlet: discard a card to give it indestructible. One of EDHREC's highest-lift cards for Hashaton. Overlaps with Trained Pronghorn, so pick one.

picks.name: Twilight Diviner
picks.why: Whenever creatures enter from your graveyard, makes a token copy of one of them. Pairs with Living Death, Sun Titan and Sister Hospitaller.

picks.name: Unexpected Assistance
picks.why: Convoke instant: draw three, discard one. Your Zombie tokens can pay for it.

skipped.name: Emptiness and Deceit
skipped.reason: Their enter abilities check what mana was spent, so a Hashaton token copy gets nothing.

skipped.name: Silvergill Peddler
skipped.reason: Only loots when tapped; weaker than the other looters.
